instruction: Rename the worksheet tab in the open spreadsheet to 'Survey2021'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter');

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to convert xlsx to html and view in Chrome. Successfully used File > Save As to change format to HTML, saved the file, switched to Chrome, and navigated to the HTML file URL. However, the agent replaced an existing tab instead of opening a new one, causing the tab URL check to fail.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc menus (File > Save As), interact with dialogs (format dropdown, save button), switch to Chrome, type URLs in address bar
metadata.failure_analysis: Model replaced an existing Chrome tab when navigating to the HTML file instead of opening a new tab. The evaluator required all 4 URLs (3 original + 1 HTML file) to be present as separate tabs.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single-step UI interaction task (renaming a worksheet tab) that tests basic LibreOffice Calc UI navigation within the model's demonstrated capability
metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming the worksheet tab. Getter reads the sheet name from the xlsx file after postconfig saves. Metric checks if name equals 'Survey2021'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the sheet name from the xlsx file at sheet index 0 using openpyxl
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter as a direct rules dict (accesses expected.get('expected_name') directly)
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before the getter reads the sheet name, ensuring the renamed tab is persisted
Expected value 'Survey2021' exactly matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: single instruction requirement (rename tab) is fully verified by the single evaluator check
Error handling is adequate: getter returns error dict for missing files, metric returns 0.0 for error results
